submissionDateModal.title: Submission Date Required
submissionDateModal.body: "{{name}}" is moving to <bold>Submitted</bold>. Enter the date it was submitted to the client — once saved, only an Admin can change it.
submissionDateModal.expiryRequiredNote: Required for a Private tender — when the quote/tender validity to this client expires.
submissionDateModal.expiryOptionalNote: Optional for a Government tender — when the quote/tender validity to this client expires, if known.
submissionDateModal.errorFutureDate: Submission date cannot be a future date.
submissionDateModal.errorExpiryRequired: Please enter the submission expiry date — required for a Private tender.

tenderForm.categoryHint: A Private tender requires a submission expiry date once it reaches Submitted — a Government one leaves that optional.
tenderForm.departmentHint: Set automatically from the tender owner.
tenderForm.currentContractEndHint: When this lead's CURRENT awarded contract (with another provider, or an existing one of ours) is due to end — if known. Flagged on the Sales Funnel Pipeline's "Contract ending soon" reminder tile once within 30 days.
tenderForm.closedDateHint: Use the real date this tender was {{outcome}} — this is what the pipeline value trend chart uses, so it's safe to backdate for past deals.
tenderForm.disqualifiedHint: Set automatically when this lead was disqualified. Stage can't be changed from here — use "Re-qualify" below (or its card in the Sales Funnel Pipeline) to send it back to New Lead instead.
tenderForm.submissionDateLockedHint: Locked after first entry — ask your Admin if this needs to change.
tenderForm.submissionDateAdminHint: Already set — as Admin you can correct it if needed.
tenderForm.submissionDateFirstHint: The date this tender was submitted to the client — can't be a future date, and can only be entered once.
tenderForm.expiryRequiredHint2: Required for a Private tender — freely correctable any time, unlike Submission Date.
tenderForm.expiryOptionalHint2: Optional for a Government tender — freely correctable any time.
tenderForm.reassignConfirm: Reassign "{{client}}" from {{from}} to {{to}}? This also moves it to {{to}}'s department, and they'll be able to see and nurture it through the pipeline from here on.
tenderForm.errorSelectCategory: Please select whether this is a Government or Private tender.
tenderForm.errorSubmissionFutureDate: Submission date cannot be a future date.
tenderForm.errorExpiryRequired: Please enter the submission expiry date — required for a Private tender.

tenderForm.errorGenericSave: Something went wrong saving this tender. Please try again.
tenderForm.confirmDelete: Delete the tender for "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
tenderForm.confirmRequalify: Re-qualify "{{name}}"? It will move back to New Lead and re-enter the pipeline from the top.

activeProjects.confirmReassignRequest:
Request reassigning "{{client}}" from {{from}} to {{to}}?

{{from}} keeps full access and its Duty Roster stays live until {{to}}'s Branch Manager accepts the move and chooses what happens to the existing duty roster.
activeProjects.confirmCancelReassignment: Cancel the pending reassignment of "{{client}}" to {{branch}}?
activeProjects.confirmBringOver: Bring over "{{client}}"'s existing duty roster? Its guards, schedule and history all move to {{branch}} as-is.
activeProjects.confirmNewRoster: Start a brand-new duty roster for "{{client}}" under {{branch}}? The existing roster is archived (kept for Admin/HQ/Payroll records) but no longer used for this project.
activeProjects.confirmCloseOut:
Close out "{{client}}"?

It will move out of Active Projects and into Past Projects, and any guards still deployed here move back into the Guard Pool. Its value keeps counting in Pipeline Analysis as Won revenue — this only affects the Active Projects view.

If this contract is simply being renewed and work is continuing without a break, edit its Contract End date (and value, if the rate changed) instead — closing out will release its guards.

renewContract.title: Renew Contract
renewContract.intro: For a contract that's continuing straight through with no real break in work — extend its end date and, if the rate changed, its value. This is the same tender, not a new deal: it keeps its site, its guards, and its place in Past Projects history untouched.
renewContract.valueHint: Leave as-is if the rate isn't changing. Changing it logs a value-change entry in this tender's history, same as any other correction.
renewContract.errorEnterEndDate: Enter the new Contract End date.
renewContract.errorEndDateBeforeCurrent: New Contract End should be after the current end date ({{date}}) — this renews the contract, it doesn't shorten it.
renewContract.errorGenericRenew: Could not renew this contract. Please try again.

projectDetails.title: Project Details
projectDetails.siteModeQuestion: Does this project run out of a single worksite, or does it have more than one site/roster under this same contract?
projectDetails.siteModeHint: This is asked once — Multiple Sites adds a "+ Add Site" option below for linking more than one Duty Roster site to this same contract; Single Site keeps this form to just the one site's details.
projectDetails.locationPlaceholder: e.g. Menara ABC, Jalan Ampang, KL
projectDetails.scopeOfWorkPlaceholder: Summarize what the contract covers — posts, shifts, duties, etc.
projectDetails.clientAlias: Client Alias / Short Code (for invoice numbers)
projectDetails.clientAddressPlaceholder: Printed on invoices, if different from the worksite location above
projectDetails.guardRateHint: (optional — bills the client per man-hour worked, read live by the Duty Roster's Summary Report)
projectDetails.rateLastChanged: Rate last changed from RM {{from}} to RM {{to}} on {{date}} by {{name}}.
projectDetails.rateChangeAdds: Adds an estimated RM {{amount}} from this project's tracked contract value (assumes {{hours}} hrs/guard/month × {{guardsText}} × {{monthsText}} remaining).
projectDetails.rateChangeRemoves: Removes an estimated RM {{amount}} from this project's tracked contract value (assumes {{hours}} hrs/guard/month × {{guardsText}} × {{monthsText}} remaining).
projectDetails.additionalEquipmentHint: (optional — e-bikes, drones and similar, billed alongside guard headcount; add an item from day one of the contract or mid-way through it)
projectDetails.equipmentAddPreview: Adds an estimated RM {{value}} to this project's tracked contract value ({{monthsText}} remaining from {{start}} to contract end).
projectDetails.linkedSitesHint: (for a client with more than one worksite/roster under this same contract; each linked site gets its own Location, Guard Rate and Additional Equipment below, while the contract value above stays combined)
projectDetails.estMonthlyValueHint: (guard rate + active equipment, right now — a snapshot for reporting, not a split of the combined contract value above)
projectDetails.noSiteYet: This project doesn't have a Duty Roster site yet — open "Duty Roster" from Active Projects first to create its first site before linking a second one here.
projectDetails.managingBranchHint: Defaults to this project's own branch. Pick a different branch if this site will run under a different one — that branch will then manage this site's own Duty Roster, Guard Rate, and invoicing, without needing access to the rest of this project.
projectDetails.addSiteRequirementsHint: Site Name, Location, Contact Person, State, City and Postcode are required to add the site. Guard Rate and Additional Equipment are optional here and can also be changed later from the site's own card — set up its guards and roster from the Duty Roster tab whenever you're ready.
projectDetails.errorInvalidGuards: Enter a valid number of guards.
projectDetails.errorInvalidRate: Enter a valid rate (RM per man-hour), or leave it blank.
projectDetails.errorGenericSave: Could not save these details. Please try again.
projectDetails.errorAddEquipment: Could not add this equipment item.
projectDetails.confirmRemoveEquipment: Remove "{{label}}" from this project's Additional Equipment? This reverses the value it added to this project's tracked contract value.
projectDetails.errorRemoveEquipment: Could not remove this equipment item.
projectDetails.errorStopEquipment: Could not stop this equipment item.
projectDetails.confirmRemoveDoc: Remove the uploaded tender document? This cannot be undone.

linkedSiteCard.managingBranchHint: Which branch runs this site's own Duty Roster, Guard Rate, and invoicing — change it to re-delegate this site to a different branch, or reclaim it, without needing to remove and re-add it.
linkedSiteCard.confirmRemoveSite: Remove "{{name}}" from this project? Its Duty Roster schedule and history stay intact for records, any guard still deployed there is released back to the Guard Pool, and there's currently no way to re-link it from here.
linkedSiteCard.errorFillEquipmentFields: Fill in item, rate, quantity and start date.
linkedSiteCard.confirmRemoveEquipment: Remove "{{label}}" from {{site}}'s Additional Equipment? This reverses the value it added to this project's tracked contract value.
linkedSiteCard.archivedHint: Archived — hidden from Duty Roster's active site picker, but its data stays intact.
linkedSiteCard.archivingHint: Archiving hides this site from Duty Roster's active site picker without losing its data.
